name: MedAgentBench
intro: MedAgentBench 是一个医疗记录智能体评测套件，包含 300 项由内科医生编写的临床任务，以及从 STARR 去标识并按患者扰动时间后构建的 100 份患者档案。任务在符合 FHIR 标准的交互式环境中运行，评估模型的规划、工具调用、信息检索与结构化操作能力。
build_method: 医生任务策展、去标识EHR抽取、FHIR环境构建
task_type: 医疗Agent, 工具调用, EHR交互
eval_feature: 八轮FHIR交互, 查询参考答案评分, 动作载荷规则评分, pass@1全量分母
official_license: MIT for the Git repository; the externally downloaded Box grader and Docker latest artifact are not revision-pinned or separately licensed in the repository
task_type_en: Medical agent, tool use, EHR interaction
build_method_en: Physician task curation, deidentified EHR extraction, FHIR environment construction
eval_feature_en: Eight-round FHIR interaction, query reference grading, action-payload rule grading, pass@1 over the full denominator
intro_en: MedAgentBench evaluates medical-record agents with 300 clinical tasks written by internal-medicine physicians and 100 patient profiles derived from STARR after deidentification and patient-level timestamp jitter. Its FHIR-compliant interactive environment tests planning, tool use, information retrieval, and structured actions.

drawio_review_note: Source audit locked to arXiv:2501.14654v2 (last revised 2025-02-12) and official Git commit 99260117137b09f04837a8c18d18a1107efa55ae checked on 2026-07-21. Construction preserves two internal-medicine physicians, 300 clinically derived inpatient/outpatient tasks curated into ten specific and seven broad categories, and a random 100-patient STARR cohort anchored on an inpatient morning sodium test dated 2023-11-13. It preserves the five-year window beginning 2018-11-13; labs, six vital-sign types, procedures, diagnoses, and medication orders; procedure-quantity imputation to one; removal of procedures missing CPT/description, diagnoses with any missing field, and PRN medication orders; patient-level timestamp jitter; deduplicated S-prefixed seven-digit synthetic MRNs; Faker US demographics; four FHIR resource families totaling 785,207 records; and HAPI FHIR JPA with persistent H2 and parallel upload. The paper frames this as easy setup, but the pinned repository contains no Dockerfile or image digest and its README pulls an unpinned latest image. The pinned repository currently selects test_data_v2.json with 300 tasks and funcs_v1.json with nine functions, while retaining a legacy 100-row test_data_v1.json. Its README still requires an externally downloaded Box refsol.py, which is not revision-pinned in Git; the repository MIT license does not separately identify those external artifacts. Evaluation follows the pinned implementation: an AgentBench-style prompt, one GET/POST/FINISH response per round, eight configured rounds, Gemini code-fence stripping, real GET execution with raw/error feedback, JSON-loadability-only POST handling without mutating the FHIR server, FINISH detection by startswith, FINISH-wrapper stripping, raw inner-text result storage without JSON parsing or validation, and full-history capture, and failure on invalid action, context/task error, or round exhaustion. An external task-prefix grader compares query responses with manually curated references or applies action-payload rules; grader exceptions are false. calculate_overall asserts one result per released task and divides correct_count by all 300 results, so null/error/limit outcomes remain in the denominator. The paper reports Overall, Query, and Action SR for 150 query and 150 action tasks under pass@1, whereas the pinned overall.json calculation emits only the overall success rate. Formal publication evidence [site-a11s-paper-alignment]: normalized Draw.io and architecture sidecars plus native fixed-light SVG/PNG pairs were regenerated from the checked-in bilingual specs. Final PNG dimensions are 2260×1425 (English) and 2241×1425 (Chinese); SVG viewBoxes are 2258×1423 and 2239×1423. The final exports were inspected without clipping, node overlap, connector-node crossing, fallback text, or adaptive colors.
